The real-Git/shared-service regression waits on pending CI, merges once on green CI, retains model-call counts and replays completed work without another mutation.
The owner checkout unsaved file, index bytes and HEAD remain unchanged during selected reconciliation.
Free merge lease admission atomically preserves command holds, PR-only ceilings and pending dispatches; productive claims remain excluded from approved waiting work.
Resumed/source-less CI waits are represented as AwaitChecks; genuine policy blocks remain Held.
